[[File:TouchOfTheKiinDray-BoS.png|thumb|A Nightsister using the Touch of the Kiin'Dray]]
The '''Touch of the Kiin'Dray''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] technique where the user could apply a binding force to their hands and feet to scramble up a cliff face or to hold a weapon in a grip that was unbreakable.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> The name of this ability was inspired by the [[Kiin'Dray]], a race of [[gaping spider]]s found on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace]], author of the ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', said the Touch of the Kiin'Dray was a reference to an ability used by the Nightsisters in [[Dave Wolverton]]'s novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''.<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 4)}}</ref>
